papers.title: Phonon fluctuation diagnostics: Origin of charge order in $A{\mathrm{V}}_{3}{\mathrm{Sb}}_{5}$ kagome metals
papers.abstract: The authors utilize phonon fluctuation diagnostics here to resolve the open question of the microscopic origin of charge density wave order in AV3Sb5 (A=K, Rb, Cs) kagome metals. Here, combining momentum-resolved ab initio calculations with ARPES measurements, they identify electron-phonon coupling as the primary driver of the lattice instability, rather than Van Hove singularities or nesting alone. Remarkably, the strongest contributions arise away from the high-symmetry M points, revealing a common mechanism across the three compounds.

papers.title: Microscopic magnetic phase evolution in the Weyl semimetal ${\mathrm{Mn}}_{3}\mathrm{Sn}$ revealed by ${μ}^{+}\mathrm{SR}$
papers.abstract: The Weyl semimetal Mn3Sn hosts a rich sequence of magnetic states. Here, the authors combine muon spin relaxation and magnetization measurements to reveal a broad crossover between helical and inverse triangular antiferromagnetic order. At low temperatures, their nearly stoichiometric sample develops a growing ferromagnetic component and slowing spin fluctuations, without evidence of static spin-glass freezing within the experimental time window. These findings suggest that low-temperature ferromagnetism can emerge independently of glassy freezing.

papers.title: Magnetic diffuse scattering study of the dipolar-octupolar pyrochlore ${\mathrm{Ce}}_{2}{\mathrm{Sn}}_{2}{\mathrm{O}}_{7}$
papers.abstract: The Ce pyrochlores Ce2X2O7 (X = Sn, Hf, Zr) have attracted considerable attention as quantum spin ice candidates. So far, much of their physics has been interpreted by considering only nearest-neighbor interactions. Here, diffuse neutron scattering reveals that these interactions fail to explain the dominant spin correlations in Ce2Sn2O7 even qualitatively. Instead, the observed correlations strikingly resemble those of classical dipolar spin ice, demonstrating a nonperturbative role of further-neighbor interactions in controlling its low-energy physics.

papers.abstract: The authors combine first-principles calculations and singular-mode functional renormalization group to show that the interlayer Ni–Ni distance controls competing orders in La3Ni2O7/LaAlO3 thin films. papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/方法学文章（混合倾向）。判断依据关键词：摘要以“We propose an accurate thermometry approach”开头，核心是提出一种测温方法，并结合“theoretical high-temperature expansion method”，同时应用/对接到已有的量子模拟实验数据（“a recent quantum simulation experiment”）。因此主体为理论方法提出，辅以对实验数据的分析应用。；研究对象：Rydberg 原子光镊阵列（Rydberg atom tweezer arrays）构成的 kagome 晶格偶极 Rydberg 模拟器（kagome lattice dipolar Rydberg simulator）中的量子系统，研究目标是该体系的温度测量（thermometry）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种精确的测温方案，该方案将关联（correlation）测量与局域磁化率（local susceptibility）测量的数据，与针对动态自旋关联的高温展开理论方法相结合，从而实现对 kagome 晶格偶极 Rydberg 模拟器的准确温度测定。摘要未明确说明具体的温度数值结果或测温精度指标。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种精确的测温方案，该方案将关联（correlation）测量与局域磁化率（local susceptibility）测量的数据，与针对动态自旋关联的高温展开理论方法相结合，从而实现对 kagome 晶格偶极 Rydberg 模拟器的准确温度测定。摘要未明确说明具体的温度数值结果或测温精度指标。；创新点：将关联与局域磁化率测量同动态自旋关联的高温展开理论相结合，提出针对 Rydberg 原子光镊阵列（kagome 晶格偶极体系）的测温方法。相对于已有研究的具体新意，摘要未突出说明（例如未明确说明与既有测温方案的定量对比或改进幅度）。
papers.method_zh: 方法上结合了三部分：(1) 关联测量（correlation measurements）；(2) 局域磁化率测量（local susceptibility measurements）；(3) 针对动态自旋关联（dynamic spin correlations）的理论高温展开方法（high-temperature expansion method）。并将该方案应用于近期的一项量子模拟实验（摘要中引用为 Borne…，具体细节摘要未完整给出）。
